title: Style tiles for "It's a Date": a web app where people share…
brief: Style tiles for "It's a Date": a web app where people share date ideas, rate them 1-5 stars, filter by tag (food, adventure, home, self-date...), and find places near them. Must feel like Airbnb (photo-first cards, 12px rounded corners, generous whitespace, sticky pill search bar, category icon row, light theme) but be its own brand: never use Airbnb red #FF385C, the Cereal font, or the Airbnb name/logo. Use free Google Fonts only. Each tile shows palette with contrast, type specimen, a date-idea card (photo, title, star rating, tag), primary/secondary buttons, the pill search bar and the category icon row.
